mapper.select: SELECT T1.TEAM_ID -- 팀아이디 , T1.TEAM_NM -- 팀명 , T1.TEAM_EXPL -- 팀설명 , T1.TEAM_CMMN_STUP_CN -- 팀공통 설정 내용(BLOB) , T1.TEAM_TSK_CLSF -- TEAM 업무 구분 , T3.CODE_NM -- 코드이름 , COALESCE(T2.USER_CNT, 0) AS USER_CNT -- 사용자건수 FROM CLOVER_TEAM T1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT TEAM_ID , COUNT(USER_ID) AS USER_CNT FROM CLOVER_USER GROUP BY TEAM_ID ) T2 ON T1.TEAM_ID = T2.TEAM_ID JOIN CLOVER_CODE T3 ON T1.TEAM_TSK_CLSF = T3.CODE::numeric AND T3.CODE_TYPE = '503' WHERE T1.TEAM_STAT = 1 AND T1.TEAM_NM LIKE '%' || #{teadNm} || '%' ORDER BY TEAM_ID ASC

SELECT TEAM_ID , TEAM_NM , TEAM_EXPL , PSNL_STUP_ACCE_YN , TEAM_CMMN_STUP_CN , TEAM_STAT , TEAM_TSK_CLSF , REG_DTTM , REGR_ID , CHNG_DTTM , CHGR_ID FROM CLOVER_TEAM WHERE TEAM_ID = #{value} ORDER BY TEAM_ID DESC
SELECT user_id , lgon_id , user_nm FROM clover_user WHERE team_id = #{teamId}
